author: jmwsca
title: could do more for untidy music libraries
content:
i have duplicates in my library and it happily added all of them and didn’t offer much in the way of managing and identifying them.  otherwise, i’m quite happy to have gotten over the initial migration pain from apple music having imported my playlists via m3u exports with manipulation because paths are absolute.  

i cannot say how refreshing it is not have to continually say no to apple music.

author: MattJRoo
title: No Support
content:
Have sent 3 emails asking for support, received absolutely nothing back, not even an acknowledgement.
It’s not a cheap app, so you would expect something.

author: B0vine Entertainment
title: The only good app
content:
It’s simple. You pay money, and get access for the rest of your life. No subscription b.s, no ads, just one simple purchase.
It’s also just a really damn good music player.

author: redtache
title: Criminally Underrated
content: Best offline player & EQ by far.  Been using it for years and it just keeps getting better.  I’d be lost without it.

author: Jason Smith GB
title: Essential Music App
content: Is constantly being updated and the developer responds to info about bugs and feedback, then gets it fixed! This is a superb program with lots of features and allows the user to do away with the horrible Apple equivalent. With EverMusic Pro/Unlock, you do not have to sync your music and just drag and drop. I use a program on my PC called iMazing which makes drag and drop a breeze. Apples sync routines are slow and drive me bonkers. I like to use my own music files I make myself and this app has saved my sanity!!! The art work routines has now been rewritten in the last month, and now this now is much better than before. Use this app every day and it’s an essential purchase!!!  Also, the new NAS feature works great.  Been playing music from my Synology DS412+.  The first time I select NAS it fails, then gives you an option for Login/Pass.  Then it gives you folders.  I sort by filename.

author: SearbyM
title: Now works very well
content: I had some teething troubles setting up this app but the help I got from their support service did the trick and now works perfectly. This was the only app I found that will stream direct from iCloud. Although the interface is a bit unimaginative it nonetheless works very well.

author: [Proem]
title: All of the music, all of the time
content:
Overjoyed to have access to all of my music collection, more than 20,000 tracks. All syncd, either online) play from Dropbox) or offline so ready to go at any time.

The app has loads of useful features including the graphic equaliser, sync options and provide helpful technical support too. I can’t recommend highly enough.

author: 22redd22
title: Used to be great, ruined by updates
content: This was a fantastic app until a series of updates totally broke it. In the first buggy update, all the album artwork stopped displaying, which was annoying but manageable - then in the update that "fixed" that problem, I lost all the content of over 70 playlists I spent hundreds of hours curating and ordering. That was the final straw.

author: Irritated in indianapolis
title: The new update ruined the app
content: Absolutely phenomenal app until the new update came out. The search feature no longer works it just brings up a blank screen and it now takes forever to load so it’s even longer now without the search feature. Really disappointing as the app was absolutely perfect until now.

author: mikepl4
title: Doesn’t sync with Mega cloud
content: Sync with Mega does not work on iPad or iPhone. Hours after connecting to the “cloud” only two songs and one album are listed in the library on my iphone. Similar on my iPad.

author: musicspirit
title: Not impressed
content:
Two major faults with this app:
1/ When you press play and a list you have compiled there is a long pause as the track buffers - as if the app is struggling to access the track. Does not play instantly as it should.
2/ When the phone is not connected to the Internet i.e. in Airplane Mode which is the ultimate test of what is actually on your phone… The tracks do not play reliably e.g.: you play one track and then tap the track above it and that track doesn’t respond… But the track you are listening to just plays again
Sort this out please developer! Otherwise it’s a waste of £2.99

title: Just what I was looking for!
content: Having recently moved my iTunes library to Dropbox, I was looking for an app to stream my music. I tried most of the competitors, but this is the one! Simple to use and decent interface, gives option to download and store music to listen to offline as well. Would like to see the 'player' interface modernised in future updates, but a great app nonetheless!

title: Needs work
content: Needs work bookmark button could be better functioning

author: [Peter.Parker]
title: Good app but with an average user interface
content:
Good app but the user interface could be improved.

The WiFi-Drive is a great idea but it doesn't allow the upload of entire folders. To upload a folder one has to create the folder with a web browser, move inside the new folder on the iPhone, move inside the source folder, highlight the files, drag/drop them in the browser, move back one level above the source and destination folders. A process that is unnecessary convoluted.

If Evermusic Pro had a more refined user interface and upload that supports folders, it would easily be better (and successful ) than other apps like VOX.

author: Critical_Thinking-101
title: Cloud FTW
content:

Thanks to the WebDAV support I can download music from my server 👍🏻😃.

Does what it says on the tin.

Keep up the good work developer this is a smashing app.
